info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows you to manage and terminate active streaming subscriptions efficiently. This endpoint is designed for clients looking to discontinue their subscription services quickly and effortlessly. Subscribers can invoke this operation to cancel their ongoing subscriptions, ensuring that they are no longer billed for future streaming services. This feature is particularly useful for users who want to streamline their service access or adjust their entertainment options. Ideal for application developers and service providers in media and entertainment sectors.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing subscription. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions to perform this action. Upon successful cancellation, a confirmation will be returned.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a subscription. Ensure that you provide all necessary information to process the cancellation effectively.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to cancel a subscription.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after the cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation process.

audit.description: Contains audit details related to the cancellation process.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on subscriptions, indicating the result of the cancellation request.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details for actions performed on the subscription.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
